raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":2984,"db1":"POSTGRESQL","query1":"SELECT DISTINCT mmsi FROM public.vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hour' AND ST_DWithin(geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(118.7, 20.1), 4326)::geography, 7000)","db2":"MYSQL","query2":"SELECT v.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN transportation.shipping_company c ON v.company_id = c.company_id WHERE v.mmsi IN (result) AND v.captain_name IS NOT NULL AND v.captain_name <> '' AND c.company_name <> '中远海运'"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"最近24小时内出现在(118.7, 20.1)半径7公里内的船舶","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi","timestamp","geom"]},{"requirement":"船长姓名不为空","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vessel"],"columns":["captain_name"]},{"requirement":"所属公司不是‘中远海运’","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vessel","MYSQL:transportation.shipping_company"],"columns":["company_id","company_name"]},{"requirement":"输出MMSI","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vessel"],"columns":["mmsi"]}],"assumptions":[]}
